{{Quote|Recently, a random spot check aboard the luxury liner ''Alamintari'', bound for the Outer Rim Territories, uncovered 10 kilos of rare Garcornian spice and a pre-recorded sound chip of a Breshig trill beast.|The fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Garcornian spice''' was a rare type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated at<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the celestial body [[Garcornia]],<ref name="For the Taking" /> a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Garcornia system/Legends|Garcornia system]]</ref> Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] of ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of Garcornian spice was attempted aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Alamintari]]'', which was traveling to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The spice was hidden in a [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]]&mdash;normally used for transporting pets at a heightened comfort level&mdash;along with a pre-recorded [[sound chip]] of a fierce [[trill beast]]. Local ground officials, fooled by the apparent growling of the creature, did not visually inspect the interior of the transportation system, although the smuggling attempt was nevertheless later discovered by [[Customs Inspector|customs inspectors]] performing a random spot check aboard the ''Alamintari''. Not long thereafter, the incident was noted in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garcornian spice was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
